description: This Java class implements a log filter that passes only log messages without additional metadata, useful for simplified on-screen logging.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter implementing LogNode that forwards only log messages, stripping metadata for simplified display.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with an optional next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters out metadata, forwarding only the message content to the next LogNode.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Retrieves the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
